calibration: B2-C1, 雅思级产出目标, 教材/真题/美剧混合输入, 痛点在产出退化
source: Normal People (Sally Rooney), 版权作品, 例句短引仅作学习引用, 全文不入库

frames.gloss: 反问立权：我有何不可——用反问为自己/他人的正当性撑腰
frames.notes: 前置 And 强化理直气壮；两章出现两次
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 She has every right to laugh，说教味；反问版一句顶住

examples.text: And why shouldn’t she laugh?
Why shouldn’t I tell anyone?

frames.frame: (I might / I think I'm going to) [V] now, if that's okay
frames.gloss: 「我可能先……了，方便的话」——软性离场/动作预告
frames.notes: 动作=预告式请求放行（不是问许可，是给对方否决窗口）。死串 if that's okay 收尾，前面挂情态降格（might / think I'm going to）。本章连出三例：离开聚会、关电视、各自成套。产出侧只会写 May I go home?（过度正式）或 I will go（生硬）。
frames.pitfall: if that's okay 读成真条件句（担心那是真的可以吗），漏掉整句「我已决定，但留台阶」的礼貌结构

examples.text: I think I'm going to go home now, if that's okay, she says.
I might head home now, if that's okay.
I'm going to switch the TV off, if that's okay.

frames.gloss: 「我也是听说的」——传闻应答短打
frames.notes: 动作=接收传闻（顺着对方的爆料确认自己听到的版本）。死串 so I hear 挂句尾，I hear (that) 挂句首。口语/邮件：You're moving to Berlin, so I hear. 产出侧只会写 I heard that…，丢掉 so 的『果然听说』味
frames.pitfall: so 读成『所以』连词，整句因果读歪；hear 漏掉现在时=持续传闻状态

examples.text: And you're with this guy Jamie now, aren't you? he says. So I hear.

frames.related: 听说三档：so I hear（应答短打）/ I hear（开场）/ or so I've heard（更收敛）

frames.gloss: 两可收束：二分后用最小否定回声收尾，不押注、不装乐观
frames.notes: 回声尾是骨架核心；变体 or maybe he’s just being cowardly, or both（降格递进同族）
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 maybe it will happen or maybe not，长而无骨；or it won’t 三词收刀

examples.text: and either a new life will begin, or it won’t.

frames.related: [S V], not really

frames.gloss: 「问题不在 X」——否认表层归因、点出真动机
frames.notes: 动作=归因否定（表面理由之外另有真章）。死串 it's not about + 名词槽。ch10 心理叙事自剖原句；口语吵架/咨询/自我分析通吃：It's not about the money, it's about respect. 产出侧只会写 the real reason is not X
frames.pitfall: about 读成『关于』的词典义，整句『跟烧水壶没关系』读歪；漏掉 maybe 的犹疑层

examples.text: maybe it's not about the flask, maybe she just wants to remind him he once fucked her in the back seat of the car they're now sitting in

frames.related: 与 It's not like [S V]（batch_01，驳对方预设）同族不同形：not about 驳归因，not like 驳类比

frames.gloss: 「反正也…，不如就…」——顺水推舟、破罐破摔式采纳
frames.notes: 动作=低成本采纳/索性。死串 might as well。so you might as well 是推荐句式（既然免费，去就是了）；I might as well be lying here 是自暴自弃版（我躺这儿跟躺哪儿都一样）。两种语用同一骨架，产出侧极高频需求、极少有人会写。
frames.pitfall: 误拆成 might + as well「也可以」学究义，丢失「横竖一样，索性」的无奈/顺推动作

examples.text: It's free, so you might as well.
I might as well be lying here, breathing the vile dust of the carpet into my lungs

frames.gloss: 然而（偏偏）还是…（强反转收束）
frames.notes: 句首 And yet＝尽管前面全部成立，仍然。比 however 更有叙事张力，雅思大作文收尾段利器。变体 and yet again；对比 But he was there
frames.pitfall: 读成 yet 的『还没』义卡壳；产出只会 but/still，丢掉让步铺垫感

examples.text: And yet he was there, whatever kind of person he was, doing it.

frames.gloss: 说得好像你真能…似的（嗤笑不可能）
frames.notes: 动作＝整句嗤笑对方设想荒谬。As if 引导独立感叹句，后接 could/would+动词原形。单说 As if! 是九十年代口语极压缩版
frames.pitfall: 当成 as if 从句找主句；产出只会写 That’s impossible for you

examples.text: As if you could find him intimidating, Connell.

frames.gloss: 轻描淡写异议：省主语甩出 Bit+形容词+反问 tag，举重若轻地批评
frames.notes: Bit 前无主语无冠词；谓语可悬空（Bit fucked-up showing these to people）。变体：Bit different from home, isn’t it?
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 It’s a bit strange that you’re showing these，客气绕远；Bit X, isn’t it? 一句点到

examples.text: Bit fucked-up showing these to people, isn’t it?
Bit different from home, isn’t it?

frames.related: Shame [S V]；Might [V], though

frames.gloss: 不情愿认领：先承认自己不太想说的事实，用冒号亮出它
frames.notes: there it is = 事实摆在这儿，回避不掉；口语亦可 But there it is.
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 But anyway, literature moves him，用 anyway 蒙混；there it is: 才有摊牌的顿挫

examples.text: But there it is: literature moves him.

frames.gloss: 抢先惊呼：坏消息还没落地，先以 Don’t tell me 挡在门口
frames.notes: 两见：Don’t tell me, she said. The communist Declan Bree.（后接碎片）/ don’t tell me he’s involved…, is he?（尾再挂 tag）
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 I hope he’s not involved…，担心式；Don’t tell me 是已经猜到的那种绝望

examples.text: don’t tell me he’s involved in this Nazi thing, is he?
Don’t tell me, she said. The communist Declan Bree.

frames.related: What’s not to like about [X]?

frames.gloss: 就在…的同时（两事同步并置）
frames.notes: 已登记 even if/even though 的显著新变体。功能差异＝不表让步而表时间同步：A 进行的同时 B 也在发生，自带张力。书面叙事高频
frames.pitfall: 读成『甚至当』；产出只会用 while，丢掉 even 的『偏偏在此时』强调

examples.text: Even as he was saying all this to himself, however, he could hear another part of his brain

frames.related: 已登记 even if/even though（让步版），此为时间同步版

frames.gloss: 反讽假想禁忌：把对方立场推向荒谬
frames.notes: 讽刺用法：假装某小事是不可触碰的禁忌。字面义（上帝不容）几乎不用
frames.pitfall: 课本只教字面；讽刺用法（must/could 情态）学习者完全不会产出，是最强的口语反讽兵器

examples.text: God forbid you might have to encounter an Asian person

frames.frame: How was I supposed to know [S V]?
frames.gloss: 「我哪知道……？」（责难式反问：这不是我的错）
frames.notes: 动作=卸责反问。死串 How am/was [sb] supposed to [V]，supposed 的「按理应当」义被借来质问期待本身不合理。吵架、辩解高频：How am I supposed to concentrate with all this noise? 产出侧只会写 How could I know?（弱一档）。
frames.pitfall: be supposed to 只会「应该」义，读成「我怎么应该知道」卡住；漏掉整句的呛人语气

examples.text: Yeah, how was I supposed to know he was fucked in the head?

frames.gloss: 我倒没想到…（竟然敢/能）
frames.notes: 动作＝表面惊讶实则嘲讽对方越界。与直肠子的『我原以为不』同形异功能，靠语境分。I didn’t think+过去时从句是死串
frames.pitfall: 读成单纯认错『我没想到』；产出只会写 I’m surprised they let you

examples.text: I didn’t think they let people from Connacht travel that far.

frames.gloss: 驳方案价值：质疑某做法的意义
frames.notes: X 为名词/what 从句指代方案；see=看出。比 that's useless 更有商量余地
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会说 it's useless；I don't see what that achieves 把'我看不出'的责任压给对方论证

examples.text: I don’t see what that achieves.

frames.frame: I don’t know how [S] (is going to) [V]
frames.gloss: 真不知道你怎么（受得了/办得到）
frames.notes: 动作＝借『不知道方法』表达怀疑或叹服，可褒可贬。I don’t know how+小句死串。褒版：I don’t know how you do it
frames.pitfall: 读成真的请教方法；产出只会写 It will be very hard for you to

examples.text: I don’t know how you’re going to manage adult life, darling

frames.gloss: 自察经验断言：以个人观察口吻给经验规律，比 I think 更有据
frames.notes: find 后常接 get/more done 等自察结果；雅思口语可直接用
frames.pitfall: B2 一律 I think I work better…，主观断言味；I find 把经验摆成观察样本

examples.text: I find I get more done if I just stay at home and study.

frames.gloss: 「我不敢想/不忍去想……」
frames.notes: 动作=不忍设想（情感回避式评注）。死串 hate to think，that 可省。安慰、追悼、后怕场景高频：I hate to think what would have happened if you hadn't called. 产出侧只会写 I don't want to imagine，缺了主语情绪卷入感。
frames.pitfall: 读成「我讨厌思考」；漏掉这是对未言明后果的战栗式回避，不是对思维活动的厌恶

examples.text: Oh, I hate to think that. I hate to think he had that on his conscience in some way.

frames.related: 同情绪回避族：I can't bear to think / I dread to think

frames.gloss: 我知道我这样很（夸张/小心眼），但…
frames.notes: 动作＝先自我定性缴械，再照说不误。I know I’m being+形容词是死串，but 常省。变体 I know this sounds [A], but…
frames.pitfall: 读成真诚道歉就完了，漏掉后半句才是重点；产出只会写 Sorry, this is dramatic, but

examples.text: I know I’m being dramatic, Connell said. It’s not like she did anything that bad.

frames.frame: I want to be (very) clear (:) [S V]
frames.gloss: 「我要把话说透：我对你毫无感觉」——亮底牌前的郑重预告
frames.notes: 动作=元话语澄清宣告。死串 I want to be clear / Let me be clear。谈判、声明、切割关系高频。产出侧只会写 I must say clearly that...。同族变体：I'll be honest with you（坦承预告，ch15）；Believe me（担保预告，ch15）——都是「先亮元话语再上货」同一动作的三件套。
frames.pitfall: 产出侧把 clear 写成 clearly（I want to be clearly✗）；漏掉冒号/新句的停顿张力

examples.text: I want to be very clear, she says. I feel nothing for you.

frames.related: I'll be honest with you, Connell, what I'm seeing here would be pretty concerning.（ch15，坦承预告变体）

frames.frame: If [S V-ed], it was only because [S V-ed]
frames.gloss: 「之所以A，只因B」——唯一归因宣告
frames.notes: 动作=归因收窄（把现象归结到底层真相）。死串 it was only because；前半 if 从句摆现象，后半主句揭根源。议论文金句骨架：If the policy appears generous, it is only because it costs the industry nothing. 产出侧只会写 The reason is that...，少了「表面/根源」的双层结构。
frames.pitfall: only 修饰对象读错（以为是 only because 的口吻词），漏掉整句「别被表象骗了，根源在此」的揭底力度

examples.text: If people appeared to behave pointlessly in grief, it was only because human life was pointless, and this was the truth that grief revealed.

frames.frame: If [S] had to make a list of [X], [Y] would be right up there
frames.gloss: 「要论……，Y 绝对排得上号」——虚拟榜单强调
frames.notes: 动作=夸张排位（不直接说「最」，虚构一张榜单让 Y 上榜顶）。死串 make a list of ... would be right up there，变体 top the list / be near the top。吐槽、夸人通用：If I had to make a list of overrated films, this would be right up there. 产出侧只会写 Sadie understands me least of all（平一档，无画面）。
frames.pitfall: right up there 读成方位「就在上面（某处）」；漏掉整句「榜单前列」的虚拟强调机制

examples.text: If I had to make a list of people who severely don't understand me, Sadie would be right up there.

frames.gloss: 「你要再敢……，我就……」——划线警告
frames.notes: 动作=底线宣告。死串 ever + again + will；变体为祈使句 + and：Say one bad thing to her ever again and I'll come back. 严肃警告与深情承诺同骨架（I'll be there if you ever need me 只需把主句换温度）。
frames.pitfall: ever 读成「曾经」；again 与 ever 叠加的「再有一次都算」极端化语气被跳读过去

examples.text: If you ever touch Marianne again, I'll kill you, he says. Okay? That's all.
Say one bad thing to her ever again and I'll come back here myself and kill you, that's it.

frames.gloss: 反问点破：以否定反问揭穿对方行为背后的真实动机
frames.notes: 反问点破族锚点。同族变体（功能同、骨架小异）：Did you think I didn’t know?（点破知情）；And you don’t think maybe you should have asked her?（点破盲点）；Do you think we don’t know…?（点破共谋）
frames.pitfall: B2 会平问 Are you going there because of her?，失去那口笃定的揭穿腔

examples.text: Isn’t that why you’re going to Trinity?

frames.related: 已登记 You mean [S V]?

frames.gloss: 感觉太像（在做某事）了，所以不愿做
frames.notes: 动作＝把眼前行为归类进一个令人抗拒的类别，解释为何退缩。too much like+V-ing 是死串，just 加强为难语气
frames.pitfall: like 后动名词读成喜好义；产出只会写 I didn’t want to do it because it seemed like

examples.text: It just felt too much like asking her for money.

frames.gloss: （某人）渐渐意识到
frames.notes: 动作＝报道一个缓慢成形的领悟，与 It occurred to（顿悟闪现）相对。it dawns on 死串，常用 It took [时间] for it to dawn on sb that 包装迟滞感
frames.pitfall: dawn 读成『黎明』本义卡住；产出只会写 Gradually she realized

examples.text: It took a long time for it to dawn on Marianne that Peggy was using the guise of her general critique of men to defend Jamie

frames.related: It occurred to [sb] that（batch_01，顿悟义）

frames.frame: It isn't that [S V], but [S V]
frames.gloss: 「不是因为她喜欢这种感觉——只是它莫名让她松了口气」：先否认真原因，再亮真原因
frames.notes: 动作=澄清否定式归因。死串 It isn't that…, but…。Not that 的完整句版。心理/议论语篇高频；产出侧自己只会写 She doesn't like it, but it relieves her（缺 It isn't that 的「澄清归因」宣告感）。
frames.pitfall: but 在此不是转折而是「而是」；读快了会把两个小句的归因关系读反

examples.text: It isn't that she likes the feeling, but it relieves her somehow.

frames.related: Not that [S V]（同族局部版）

frames.gloss: 某人（突然）想到/意识到
frames.notes: 心理叙事标准报道框架，Rooney 全书高频引擎之一。动作＝念头闪现的客观报道，主语让位给 it。变体 it didn't occur to sb that（压根没想到）
frames.pitfall: occur 读成『发生』，整句误为『这事发生在她身上』；产出只会写 I suddenly thought

examples.text: It occurred to Marianne how much she wanted to see him having sex with someone

frames.gloss: 「他这才头一回猛然意识到…」——念头猝然击中
frames.notes: 动作=猛然意识到（区别于 it seems to sb 的持续印象：strike 是瞬间击中）。死串 it strikes sb that。产出侧只会写 he suddenly realizes，丢掉「以念头为主语、人为宾语」的被动感。
frames.pitfall: strike 读成「打击」实景义卡住；that 常被省略，读的层面找不到连词会读慢

examples.text: It strikes him now for the first time that they've placed a glass screen between this woman and the people in the waiting room

frames.gloss: 「（真不）像某人的作风」——作风基线比对
frames.notes: 动作=人格基线比对（拿眼前行为对照某人一贯的样）。死串 It's like/unlike [sb] to [V]，so 可前置加码（so unlike him）。叙事评注与日常判断两用：It's not like her to be late. 产出侧只会写 He didn't usually do that（丢了「基线 vs 偏离」的对照结构）。
frames.pitfall: like 读成「喜欢」；unlike him 空转成「不像他这个人」，漏掉后接不定式才是作风判定点

examples.text: It was so unlike him to behave that way in public

frames.related: It's [A] of [sb] to [V]（batch_01）——那条评人品（kind of you），本条比对作风基线，同槽不同动作

frames.gloss: 又不是…/又不是说…（驳对方预设）
frames.notes: 撇清动作：反驳对方暗含的因果或指控。口语天天见：It's not like I care. / It's not like you have a choice. 常配 anyway 收尾
frames.pitfall: like 后接整句没反应过来；产出只会写 It's not because...

examples.text: It wasn't like he deeply cared to know.
It wasn't like she was so attractive.

frames.gloss: 我确信…（其实压根不信，阴阳怪气）
frames.notes: 动作＝用确信口吻说对方明显不可能的事，完成挖苦。I’m sure+小句死串，与真诚版同形，靠内容荒谬度分。变体 I’m sure that’s true
frames.pitfall: 读成真的相信；产出只会写 Of course they never thought of that

examples.text: Yeah, I’m sure they’ve just never thought of that.

frames.gloss: 愿…（祝愿/诅咒，书面壳口语常反讽）
frames.notes: 动作＝正式祝愿或毒奶诅咒。May 倒装提前是死结构。口语里挂宏大主语（revolution/the odds）多带反讽
frames.pitfall: 读成『可能』may 的陈述句；产出只会写 I hope the revolution will be…

examples.text: May the revolution be swift and brutal.

frames.gloss: 「我想说的（更准确地）是……」——澄清论点重心
frames.notes: 动作=纠偏（对方听岔了重点，把话拉回主线）。死串 My point is that，加 more 是降一格自纠（『这么说吧，重点是……』）。口语、议论文、邮件通用。产出侧只会写 What I want to say is…，啰嗦
frames.pitfall: more 读成『更多』误以为在比较数量；point 读成『点』字面义卡住

examples.text: My point is more that it wouldn't have mattered even if you did tell people.

frames.gloss: 难怪…
frames.notes: 动作＝由果溯因，给刚听到的信息补一句『这下说通了』。No wonder 死串，主句照陈述语序不倒装。变体 (It’s) no wonder (that)… / Little wonder（书面）
frames.pitfall: wonder 读成『想知道』，整句误为『不奇怪是否…』；产出只会写 So that’s why

examples.text: No wonder you have no friends, you can’t even have a normal conversation.

frames.gloss: 先驳后认：no 抵抗后立刻用 yeah 倒戈认领
frames.notes: 口语对白固定双拍；反序 Yeah, no 亦常见（认领后回拒）。读不懂会全盘误解应答
frames.pitfall: B2 读成拒绝（判据二a 会读错）；自己更只会单字应答

examples.text: No, yeah.

frames.gloss: 省略式否定应答：以 Not + 悬空片段独立应答（比较级/形容词/小句）
frames.notes: 省主语系的应答位，一章三见：Not as well as yourself!（比较抢答）/ Not sure I’d be their type.（犹疑）/ Not even anyone good.（降格）
frames.pitfall: B2 会补全整句 She did not do as well as you；母语者口语在省略里显档次

examples.text: Not as well as yourself!
Not sure I’d be their type.
Not even anyone good.

frames.related: 已登记 Not that [S V]

frames.gloss: 保留性称赞：以参照物 X 的标准低为台阶，litotes 式抬一句
frames.notes: Not bad 主导 + for [参照系] + 反问 tag 收口；自夸/夸人两用
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 It’s quite good for campus accommodation，直给；Not bad for…, is it? 才有那口矜持的得意

examples.text: Not bad for campus accommodation, is it?

frames.related: Not [片段] 应答省略

frames.frame: Not for the first time, [S V]
frames.gloss: 「这已不是第一次……」（又来了——叙事反讽标记）
frames.notes: 动作=反讽式频次标定。死串 Not for the first time 前置，预告读者「此人有前科/这是惯性行为」。报刊评论与小说心理叙事都爱用：Not for the first time, he wondered whether he had made a mistake. 产出侧只会平铺 This was not the first time she thought...，失了倒装开头的冷眼腔。
frames.pitfall: 直译「不是为了第一次」当场卡住；或读懂了字面但漏掉叙事者的揶揄口吻

examples.text: Not for the first time Marianne thinks cruelty does not only hurt the victim, but the perpetrator also, and maybe more deeply and more permanently.

frames.gloss: 先撇一句「倒不是说…」，预防对方误解或自我撤回
frames.notes: 动作=预防性撇清。死串 Not that 直接挂小句，可独立成句（Not that I care.）也可接 but 收尾。邮件、聊天里母语者天天用；产出侧只会写 I don't mean that...，啰嗦且没那味。变体：Not that it matters / Not that I'm complaining。
frames.pitfall: 把 Not that 读成「不是那个」而卡住；漏掉整句的「我先把丑话说在前面/自我找补」语气

examples.text: Not that I'm saying this guy Lukas is going to be your boyfriend or would want to talk to me about football

frames.related: 与 It isn't that [X], but [Y] 同族不同形：Not that 是局部撇清，It isn't that 是整句澄清

frames.gloss: 据我所见/所知并非如此（留余地的否定回答）
frames.notes: clipped 应答框架：Not that I've seen / Not that I noticed / Not that I know of。动作＝给否定打观察范围折扣，比直接 No 更严谨也更冷。同族：Not that I remember
frames.pitfall: 读成『没有什么我看见的』逐词直译；或当成省略主语的病句跳过

examples.text: Not that I've seen.

frames.related: 口语应答省略族

frames.frame: Nothing could be further from [X] than [Y]
frames.gloss: 「离他脑子最远的事就是…」——斩钉截铁否认某念头
frames.notes: 动作=极限否认（拿最不可能的选项定位差距）。死串 Nothing could be further from。谈话、辩论、职场邮件都高频。产出侧只会写 He never thinks about it，力度差一个量级。变体：be further from the truth。
frames.pitfall: further from 字面「更远」引申不出「最不沾边」，读的层面会读成距离比较的实景义

examples.text: Nothing could be further from his mind than committing mass murder.

frames.related: nothing less than（已登记，功能同为极限强调但方向相反：抬到最高 vs 贬到最远）

frames.gloss: 再没有比这更…的了（极限强调）
frames.notes: 用 nothing 做极限参照系：Nothing could be further from the truth / Nothing would feel more exhilarating。动作＝把某事推到『无出其右』。比较级形式、否定意义
frames.pitfall: 读到否定词以为句子在否定（『没什么更普通的』字面绕住）；产出只会写 very/extremely 平调

examples.text: He said this like nothing could be more ordinary to him.
Nothing would feel more exhilarating to her at this moment than to say:

frames.related: more [A] than anyone had thought（同属超越预期族，此为极限版）

frames.gloss: 「在心里某一层，其实……」——分层承认
frames.notes: 动作=部分承认（不全盘接受，但承认有一层是真的）。死串 on some level。自我剖析与说服性写作都好用：On some level, we all know the deadline is unrealistic. 产出侧只会写 in some way / to some extent（程度弱化），没有 on some level 的「心智分层」画面。
frames.pitfall: level 读成「水平/层级」实义，整句误为「在某个阶段」；漏掉「理智不认、心底认」的自觉感

examples.text: On some level she knows that he can't have intended to hit her

frames.gloss: 「（只要）你说……，我就……」——口语假设承诺
frames.notes: 动作=条件让渡（Say 已虚化为 Suppose，让对方一句话决定自己的行动）。死串 Say + 完整小句 + and + will。表态忠心、放权专用：Say the word and I'll be there. 产出侧只会写 If you say you want me to stay, I will stay（语法对，口语味全失）。
frames.pitfall: Say 读成祈使「说！」然后干等宾语；漏掉它已是口语条件标记，整句为「你点头我就照办」

examples.text: Say you want me to stay and I will.

frames.related: If you ever [V] (again), [S]'ll [V]（batch_07）的祈使+and 变体同壳不同功能：那条是划线警告，本条是让步假设

frames.gloss: 口语给理由：seeing as 替代 because/since，语气松弛不掉书袋
frames.notes: 带 how 更爱尔兰/口语；书面禁用但口语地道度极高
frames.pitfall: B2 只会 since/because；seeing as 是口语因果的地道门票，且自带闲聊腔

examples.text: Seeing as how you fuck her every day after school.

frames.related: 已登记 not least because

frames.gloss: 省略式惋惜：It’s a shame that 压缩成两词开头的口语小句
frames.notes: 省主语系（Bit X / Shame X / Might V, though）中惋惜位成员
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 It’s a pity that Marianne didn’t come，完整但啰嗦；Shame she didn’t come 是母语者长度

examples.text: Shame Marianne didn’t come in the end, Eric said.

frames.related: Bit [A], isn’t it?

frames.gloss: 我是不是该（觉得被冒犯/生气）？（反讽自检）
frames.notes: 动作＝用进行时自问反讽对方的言行本该激怒自己。should+be V-ing 进行时是死结构，换成陈述语气就没刺了
frames.pitfall: 读成真诚征求意见；产出只会写 I think I should feel insulted

examples.text: Should I be feeling insulted? he says.

frames.frame: That says more about [X] than it does about [Y]
frames.gloss: 归因转移：这事更能说明的是 X 而非 Y，把评价的靶子换位
frames.notes: X 位常插同位语再补刀；议论利器
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 This reflects his character more than hers，结构在但 says 更狠、it does 回声更地道

examples.text: That says more about him, the supposedly ordinary and healthy person, than it does about her.

frames.related: 已登记 more [A] than anyone had thought

frames.gloss: （他）就是那样的人/事情就是这样（定论收尾）
frames.notes: 动作＝接受现状/本性归因，把讨论钉死。变体：That's just the way it has to be / Is that just the way he is? / the way it works / That's how it goes
frames.pitfall: 产出只会写 the reality is like this / his character is like that，chinglish 味重

examples.text: That's just the way it has to be.
Is that just the way he is?

frames.gloss: 「上回见她时一切还正常」——用首末次事件钉住时间做今昔对比
frames.notes: 动作=首末次锚定。the first time / the last time 名词短语直接作连词（后挂完整小句），死件是 the+序 time+零连词。last time 版自带物是人非感，叙事和口语都高频。产出侧只会写 When he saw her last, ...。
frames.pitfall: 读的层面会等 when/that 而卡；产出层面把 the last time 写成 last time（泛指义丢失）或 when ... lastly（错）

examples.text: The first time it happened he thought he was losing his mind
The last time he'd seen her, everything had been normal.

frames.frame: The idea that [X] had never occurred to [sb] before
frames.gloss: 顿悟缺席：某观念此前从未进入某人脑海（此刻才被点亮）
frames.notes: 已登记 It occurred to sb that 的显著变体：负向+主语前置，功能差异=强调从没想到（而非想到）
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 He had never thought of that idea，动作重复、无叙事时间纵深

examples.text: The idea that Marianne’s family considered themselves superior to himself and Lorraine, too good to be associated with them, had never occurred to him before.

frames.related: 已登记 It occurred to sb that

frames.gloss: 还有更糟的呢（比惨式安慰/顶回去）
frames.notes: 动作＝用『更糟存在』压低当前威胁，可安慰可抬杠。死串 There are worse things than 撑住。变体 There are worse things in life / could be worse（降级版）
frames.pitfall: 读成客观比较句，漏掉话里的抬杠劲；产出只会写 It’s not the worst thing

examples.text: There are worse things than getting beaten up.

frames.gloss: 「她身上没有半点高人一等之处」——全盘抹掉某特质
frames.notes: 动作=整人否认可命名特质。死串 there is nothing + about。about 挂「某人身上」是关键死件，产出侧只会写 She is not superior at all，缺「身上毫无…之处」的质感。口语书面都活。
frames.pitfall: about 被读成「关于」，整句卡住；at all 收尾加强容易被忽略

examples.text: There is nothing superior about her at all.

frames.frame: There's something [A] about [X/the way S V]
frames.gloss: 「X 身上有点什么……说不清但就是」
frames.notes: 动作=具体但难名的感受。死串 There's something about + 名词/way 从句。batch_06 收过否定版 There is nothing [adj] about（排除嫌疑），本批是肯定版（倾心/着迷）——显著新变体，功能相反：一个说『他身上没那种东西』，一个说『就是有那种东西』。产出侧只会写 He has a special quality
frames.pitfall: about 的『身上/里头』引申义卡壳；something 读成『某物』实义

examples.text: There was something so satisfying about the way he studied the table and lined the shots up
There’s something so corrupt and sexy about it.
There's something frightening about her, some huge emptiness in the pit of her being.

frames.related: batch_06『There is nothing [adj] about [sb/sth]』的肯定版变体

frames.gloss: 「这种事难免的」——宽慰/大事化小套语
frames.notes: 动作=安慰（告诉对方别往心里去，不是谁的错）。死串 These things happen 复数泛指+一般现在时=『世事如此』。安慰三连：Sorry about last night → Forget about it → These things happen。产出侧只会写 this kind of thing often happens，丢掉套语的收口感
frames.pitfall: 读成『这些事情正在发生』进行时义；单数化写成 This thing happens

examples.text: You didn't attack me, he says. These things happen.

frames.gloss: 情感预置评注：先把说话人对后续内容的情感反应挂在句首，再陈述事实本身
frames.notes: 与 admitted 家族不同：这里评注的是'我的感受'而非'我承认的论点'。槽位名词限于 relief/surprise/dismay/annoyement/horror/delight 等
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会写 He was relieved that... 平铺句；前置后主句可专注于事实，语气更从容书面

examples.text: To his relief, Helen dropped this specific theme

frames.related: admittedly/granted/to be sure（已登记）

frames.gloss: 又不是人人都能…（反讽特权）
frames.notes: 动作＝用全称否定反讽对方站着说话不腰疼。We can’t all 死串，后接对方享有的条件。变体 We can’t all be geniuses like you
frames.pitfall: 读成客观陈述『我们不可能全都』；产出只会写 Not everyone can afford that

examples.text: We can’t all go to private school, you know.

frames.gloss: 反问辩护：以 ever 反问对方受过的伤害，证明被辩护者清白
frames.notes: 口语护人/自辩两用；ever 是骨架核心（从无一次）。变体：what have I ever done?
frames.pitfall: B2 会说 She never did anything bad to you，平淡且弱；ever 反问自带道德压力

examples.text: What has she ever done to any of you?
That’s insane, what have I ever done?

frames.gloss: 「他这是干什么？/怎么好端端……」——质问反常行为
frames.notes: 动作=惊诧质问（已把行为定性为出格，逼对方解释）。死串 What is/are [sb] doing + V-ing，doing 后挂的才是被质问的动作；地点版 What is he doing here? 同族。抓包、吵架天天用：What are you doing talking to her? 产出侧只会写 Why is he paying you in cash?（普通疑问，丢了「这不对劲」的预判）。
frames.pitfall: doing 读成进行时「正在做」，把整句当事实询问；漏掉这是「行为反常」的指责句式，答非所问

examples.text: What is he doing paying you in cash?

frames.gloss: 「叫什么来着？」——again 追加成「提醒我一下」，礼貌求再述
frames.notes: 动作=礼貌调取记忆。死串仅一个 again，但它把普通疑问句改造成「我知道你知道，我只是忘了」的应答预期框架。口语点单、问路、回话名天天用：What's your name again? / What was that address again?。产出侧只会重问一遍 How do you spell your name?，少了那层「我知道我们说过」的熟络感。
frames.pitfall: again 读成「再问一次」，把整句误为对方没听清的重复发问，丢掉「我忘了、麻烦再说一遍」的软性功能

examples.text: What was her name again? she says. The girl at the bar.

frames.gloss: 反问表完美：以反向问句宣称 X 挑不出毛病
frames.notes: 修辞问句，常伴调侃；答话人一字不容置喙
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 Everyone should like you / There’s nothing to dislike，正面平推；反问版把举证责任甩给对方

examples.text: What’s not to like about you?

frames.related: What has [X] ever done to [Y]?

frames.gloss: 「无论被尊重还是被看不起，到头来都一样」——两极归一
frames.notes: 动作=枚举两极后宣布殊途同归。死串 Whether…or…, it…。宾语从句版 whether she was respected or despised 单独出现时是初中语法；值得登记的是「让步式两极 + 归一主句」整骨架。产出侧只会写 No matter what happens, it is the same。
frames.pitfall: 读的层面易把 whether…or 误判为悬而未决的疑问（「是否」义），实际是已归一的让步

examples.text: Whether she was respected or despised, it didn't make much difference in the end.

frames.gloss: 谁不想…呢（反诘：人人都想/都该）
frames.notes: 动作＝用全称反问把有争议的愿望说成天经地义，可自嘲可开脱。who wouldn’t 死串。同族：Who doesn’t want to…?
frames.pitfall: 读成在问具体哪个人；产出只会写 Everyone would want to

examples.text: Who wouldn’t want to beat me up?

frames.gloss: 你到底为什么会…（质疑行为本身不合常理）
frames.notes: 疑问句里嵌 even＝针对『居然/还』的难以置信。动作＝质疑对方做此事的资格或逻辑。变体 How do you even know / Why did you even come
frames.pitfall: even 漏读，整句斥责语气全丢；产出只会写 why ... at all，生硬

examples.text: Why are you even out here if you think it was so funny?

frames.gloss: 「你还记得（那天/那次）……的时候吗」——引旧事开场
frames.notes: 动作=私人记忆调取。死串 You know when + 从句，期待对方接 Yes 补全共享记忆，然后自己展开正题。聊天破冰神器：You know when you said you'd always be there for me? 产出侧只会写 Do you remember that night?，缺了 when 从句直接挂具体场景的利落。
frames.pitfall: 读成真疑问句（等对方回答时间点），实际是自答式话头，重心在后面的正题

examples.text: You know when we were dancing last night?

frames.related: 同族：You know how [S V]? / You know what?

frames.gloss: 你是说…？（顺对方话头确认/改述）
frames.notes: 陈述句语序+问号＝确认反问，动作＝把对方的话翻译成自己的版本再抛回，可含反驳：So you mean they don't care at all?
frames.pitfall: 读成普通陈述句错过反问语气；产出写 Do you mean that...（语法对但失去顺势重述的锋利）

examples.text: You mean they're not interested in the world around them.
You mean, you don't want to take my side, she said.

frames.gloss: 你真该听听/看看（言外：离谱得很）
frames.notes: 动作＝用虚拟建议转述离谱内容，邀请对方共享震惊。should+感官动词是死串，不是真建议。同族：You should have seen [X]（亲见版）
frames.pitfall: 读成建议对方真的去听；产出只会写 People in town say bad things about you

examples.text: You should hear what people in town say about you.

frames.gloss: 你觉得这就算…？（更狠的在后面）
frames.notes: 动作＝借用对方的评价当靶子，反手给出更极端的版本。You think…? 设靶+陈述揭底两截。变体 You call that [N]?
frames.pitfall: 读成确认对方观点；产出只会写 It’s actually worse than that

examples.text: You think that’s bad? By male standards he’s a prince.

frames.related: 设靶（与 batch_02 You hear that 同功能异形）

frames.gloss: 你这是找…呢（警告对方行为招祸）
frames.notes: 动作＝把对方言行解读为『自找』某种下场。want to 在此不是意愿而是『活该/招惹』。同族：You want to be careful / You want to watch yourself
frames.pitfall: 读成真实意愿『你想要被打』；产出只会写 That will get you beaten up

examples.text: You want to get beaten up by the Gardaí.

frames.related: 爱尔兰/英式口语

frames.gloss: 「照理说该……（可实际相反）」——戳破合理预期
frames.notes: 动作=预期落空反讽（=『你会以为，但你错了』）。死串 You'd think，后接虚拟主句。You'd think they would jump at the idea…=他们居然不抢，讽刺拉满。产出侧只会写 theoretically they should…，丢掉 You'd think 的反讽口吻。变体：You'd think (that)…
frames.pitfall: You'd think 读成『你会想』的一般陈述，丢失『以为≠实际』的落差；漏掉 would 的虚拟味

examples.text: You'd think they would jump at the idea of multiple partners.

frames.gloss: 「A 跟 B 比起来算不了什么」——比值贬低
frames.notes: 动作=程度碾压（用 nothing to 把 A 在 B 面前归零）。死串 be nothing to，A 与 to 后的 B 须同类可比。今昔对比、轻重权衡好用：My problems are nothing to what she went through. 产出侧只会写 A is much smaller than B（失去归零的决绝）。
frames.pitfall: nothing to 读成「对……什么都不是」误为人际冷漠；漏掉这是比较级替换件（≈ nothing compared to）

examples.text: the pain of loneliness will be nothing to the pain that she used to feel, of being unworthy.

frames.related: nothing less than / nothing short of（已编）同 nothing 强调族；本条是把比较句装进 nothing to 壳

frames.gloss: 反复无常对照：一分钟这样、下一分钟那样，钉死摇摆
frames.notes: one minute…then…the next；省谓语，靠副词对撞
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 sometimes smug and sometimes servile，无画面；one minute/the next 有钟表滴答的节奏

examples.text: unpleasantly smug one minute and then abasing themselves to show off their good manners the next

frames.gloss: 「让人发怵的是那个方式——一进屋谈话就戛然而止」：用 the way 从句给现象点名
frames.notes: 动作=把「某种情形发生的方式」钉为主语作评价。the way 后直接挂完整小句（无 that），死件是 the way+零连词。挂主语位是产出痛点：读得懂，自己只会写 the fact that。变体：the way he just walked out, the things she said…（同族的 the+N+wh 挂主语）。
frames.pitfall: the way 后无 that 无 how，读的层面会等一个连词而卡顿；误以为 the way 是状语（「以…方式」修饰动词），实为主语复指

examples.text: At first it was unsettling, the way eyes turned away from her in a room

frames.gloss: 尾缀降调断言：把 I don’t think 从句首移到句尾做软化垫
frames.notes: 否定提升的口语变体；说完再补猜疑，语气松弛
frames.pitfall: B2 只会句首 I don’t think I was compatible…，语序一换全然更口语

examples.text: I wasn’t that compatible with Rachel, I don’t think.

frames.related: [S V], not really

frames.gloss: 结果却发现…（事与愿违的收尾）/只为…（目的小句）
frames.notes: 一串两功能要分开：①意外结果版（赶回家 only to find 门已锁）是主干，动作＝落空收尾；②目的版（来 only to test her）＝『只为』。文中出现的是②，①加自造例
frames.pitfall: only 读成『仅仅』或当目的状语一律放过；产出从不使用这个收尾利器

examples.text: as if Connell had been visiting her house only to test her
He rushed home, only to find the door locked.
He touches his own face, only to discover that he has started crying.

frames.gloss: 逼问定性：陈述后甩 or what? 逼对方在给定标签里认领
frames.notes: 问句尾缀固定；不耐烦/审问口吻
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 right? / isn’t it?，礼貌求确认；or what? 是拍桌子的那种确认

examples.text: You were just doing it for the laugh, or what?

frames.gloss: 驳手段效力：指出靠某做法达不到目标
frames.notes: by V-ing 指出被质疑的手段；常配 obviously/simply
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会说 Talking won't solve it；not going to V by V-ing 保留了'拿你的手段开刀'的靶子结构

examples.text: Obviously we’re not going to save the Middle East by talking about it at a house party.

frames.gloss: 看得出来/能察觉（凭迹象判断）
frames.notes: tell＝辨别而非告诉，B2-C1 最顽固的读坑之一。变体：You can tell he's lying / I can't tell whether... / sb could see that（同族补一笔认知）
frames.pitfall: tell 一律读『告诉』，整句卡死；产出只会写 I can know / I can feel

examples.text: he can tell he has lost his footing in their discussion
She can't tell immediately whether he's being sincere or mocking.

frames.gloss: 那总可以…吧（递一个明显不靠谱的招）
frames.notes: 动作＝抛出名义上可行实则刻薄的建议。could always 死串，always 是反讽发生器。变体 You could always just leave
frames.pitfall: 读成热心支招；产出只会写 Maybe they should try to quit drugs

examples.text: They could always try, I don’t know, giving up drugs? says Jamie.

frames.frame: [S] could do worse than [V] / than [being N]
frames.gloss: 「比…差的选择有的是」= 委婉给好评，说 X 已算不错的选择
frames.notes: 动作=降格式夸奖（拿更差的假想选项垫底）。死串 could do worse than。语气含蓄带幽默，雅思口语/写作里替代 you should definitely... 很出彩。原文是「你要是当动物，投胎成鹿已经不错了」。
frames.pitfall: 读到 worse 以为在说对方差，整句 polarity 读反；自己产出只会写 X is a good choice

examples.text: If you were an animal yourself, you could do worse than be a deer.

frames.gloss: （兜兜转转）最终落得/结果成了
frames.notes: 已登记 What began as [X] ended up [Y] 的基础引擎，单独更常用：强调结局的非计划性。槽位可接 V-ing / adj / prep短语（end up in trouble）
frames.pitfall: 产出写成 end up to do（动词形式错）；或只用 finally，丢掉『 unintended outcome』味

examples.text: Anyway, he did end up taking her to see the ghost estate.

frames.related: What began as [X] ended up [Y]（叙事对照版）

frames.gloss: 发现自己（不知不觉）在做某事
frames.notes: 动作＝出乎意料的自我状态报道，暗含『不是故意的』。两章两见。变体 find oneself in a position/situation
frames.pitfall: 读成『找到自己』；产出只会写 I discovered that I was doing

examples.text: he also finds himself fantasising about things he could say to impress her
He found himself fantasising about her in class that afternoon
Connell went to leave but found himself trapped by a group of students talking loudly
he finds himself signing in for dinner on the scholars' website and eating Commons in the Dining Hall

frames.gloss: 情绪旁注：动词与 that 从句之间插入 to one’s surprise 类情绪短语
frames.notes: to his surprise/relief/dismay 一族；插入位是骨架核心（非句首）
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 Surprisingly, he found that…，副词打头太平；插入式才有叙事者的迟一拍惊讶

examples.text: He found, to his surprise, that the idea made him furious.

frames.gloss: 听见自己（用一种…的声音）说出
frames.notes: 动作＝陌生化报道自己脱口而出的话，暗含『话不受我控制』。heard oneself saying 死串，中间可插声音状语。文学叙事高频
frames.pitfall: 读成物理上听到回声；产出只会写 She said in a cold voice

examples.text: Marianne heard herself in a voice like hard ice saying

frames.gloss: 「他要是还在，也会希望……」——替不在场者代言意愿
frames.notes: 动作=虚拟代言（为亡者/缺席者转述其本该有的意愿）。死串 would have wanted。悼词、遗物交接、安慰场景专用：Your father would have wanted you to have this. 产出侧只会写 He wanted to apologise when he was alive，完全造不出这层虚拟敬意。
frames.pitfall: would have 虚拟味丢失，读成「他曾经想要」（把亡者当活人转述），整句的悼亡温度没了

examples.text: He was saying Rob would have wanted to apologise.
I'm sure Rob would have wanted to apologise, to be honest.

frames.gloss: 「我不是那种爱……的人」——自我归类式撇清
frames.notes: 动作=人设声明（用『我这类人』下断言，比直说 I don't like X 轻）。死串 a [N] person / a big [N] person。口语天天见：I'm not a big breakfast person / not a cat person / not a religious person, but… 两章两见（Mass person / religious person）。产出侧只会写 I don't really like Mass
frames.pitfall: 把 a big Mass person 读成『一个大人物』；漏掉 big 是加强『铁杆』义

examples.text: I'm not a big Mass person.
I'm not a religious person but I do sometimes think God made you for me.

frames.gloss: （转述/自思）那是何等…（感叹内容嵌入从句）
frames.notes: 已登记 How/What 感叹的显著新变体：间接感叹句。功能差异＝感叹不再是独立句子而是 think about/realise/see 的宾语从句，用于自由间接引语。误读点在 what/how 不是疑问词
frames.pitfall: 把 what a secretive person 当疑问结构（『什么一个人』）；产出只会写 such a ... person 平调陈述

examples.text: He was thinking about what a secretive, independent-minded person Marianne was
How much terrifying and bewildering status would accrue to her in this one moment

frames.related: 已登记 How/What 感叹（独立句版）

frames.gloss: 迟到顿悟：回望发现某事从头到尾就是如此
frames.notes: 与过去完成时绑死；all along 落在句尾。常接 He knew then that… 引导
frames.pitfall: B2 会说 the secret was actually trivial，丢掉一直在那儿只是你没看见的时间纵深

examples.text: had been trivial all along, and worthless.

frames.related: The idea that [X] had never occurred to [sb]

frames.gloss: …还是怎么的/之类的（含糊收尾）
frames.notes: 模糊补白动作：话说一半留白。or something 挂在不确定断言后；or anything 挂在否定后（『压根没做什么』的宽域否定）。同族：as some kind of [N]（带贬抑的模糊定性）
frames.pitfall: 读成『或者任何东西』实义；产出整句缺这层含糊味，显得过笃定

examples.text: Connell has heard she has a mental illness now or something
I wouldn't say that to people or anything.

frames.gloss: 给某人的感觉是…/在某人看来像是…
frames.notes: 印象归因框架，替代 give sb the impression of。变体 It strikes me that...（我觉得…）；as 槽可接 noun/adj/V-ing
frames.pitfall: strike 读成『打击』，整句误解；介词误用 strike to sb

examples.text: This struck her as a highly cryptic and sophisticated thing to say.

frames.gloss: 「没有你就不是原来那个味了」——以缺谁定性变化
frames.notes: 动作=缺席预告/煽情收尾。死串 won't be the same without。离别邮件、告别致辞、追忆高频；原文是邮件里最戳的一句。产出侧只会写 You will be missed（被动句平庸版）。
frames.pitfall: the same 指「原样」而非「同一个人」，读快易误解；产出侧常画蛇添足写成 won't be same

examples.text: Won't be the same without you, he wrote.

frames.gloss: 揭穿词义：顺着对方的用词，用 by which she means 翻译出其真实含义
frames.notes: 定语从句挂刚出现的引语/术语后；讽刺利器，essay 亦可驯化使用
frames.pitfall: B2 会另起一句 which actually means…，丢掉 by which 一口气滑出的揭穿感

examples.text: by which she means the ability to beg for love from people who hate her.

frames.related: 已登记 [S V], which [谓语]

frames.gloss: 动作伴随意外发现：做完某动作后发现出乎意料的情况
frames.notes: to find 表结果性意外，不表目的。主句动词多为 look up/arrive/come home/wake up 类
frames.pitfall: 学习者会写成 when he looked up, hours had passed（对但平）；to find 一词收束'一抬头竟然'的意外感，书面口语都高频

examples.text: he’s looked up to find that hours have gone by
coming up from the U-Bahn station in Schönleinstraße to find it was suddenly dark out

frames.related: only to [V]（已登记：结果常带挫败感；to find 中性偏意外）

frames.gloss: 降调修正：断言说完，尾缀 not really 把自己刚下的结论调低一档
frames.notes: 逗号隔开的尾注，非句中副词；自评/自辩两用
frames.pitfall: B2 会把 really 塞进句中 (it wouldn’t really matter)，丢掉先斩后收的口语节奏

examples.text: But it wouldn’t matter if she did tell her, not really.

frames.related: either [X], or it won’t

frames.frame: [完整陈述], that was clear / [S] knew that / and it did
frames.gloss: 回环盖章：陈述说完，追加一个回指小句给它定调盖章
frames.notes: 回指小句用 that/it 代词：that was clear（明晰盖章）/ he knew that（执念盖章）/ and it did（验证盖章）/ Connell is certain of this（笃定盖章）
frames.pitfall: B2 会用副词（clearly, obviously）前置打头；回环 tag 才有先陈述后定音的节奏

examples.text: No one else would invite her to the Debs, that was clear.
People are watching them shake hands, Connell is certain of this.
He knew Rachel would see him and wait with him, he knew that.

frames.related: [S V], I don’t think

frames.gloss: 反问自答：陈述后甩出 why would he/she，宣示该问题根本不成立
frames.notes: 口语高频；why would [代词] 单独成尾问，前面主句已给出理由。变体：what does that matter? / why would he lie?。挂锚点：自问自答族
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 because he doesn't care 之类的完整解释句，语气平；此骨架一句收束

examples.text: He never thinks about the man who got Lorraine pregnant, why would he?

frames.related: 设问自答降格；已登记 Why are you even V-ing（功能不同：彼为质疑他人，此为自答）

frames.gloss: （针对前面整件事）这一点…（就整句发表评注）
frames.notes: 句级 which 指代整个前句而非最近名词。动作＝升一层对前句下断语。变体：which he didn't and would never do（用 which 直接否认前句内容）
frames.pitfall: which 找错先行词（挂到最近名词上），整句评注读成局部描述；产出几乎不敢用

examples.text: It expresses everything all at once, which is the same as expressing nothing.
which he didn't and would never do

frames.frame: [时间量 N] into [阶段 N], [S V]
frames.gloss: 「新年才过几天，他就收到了短信」——进入某阶段后的第 N 时间
frames.notes: 动作=以阶段进程锚定时间。死串「量词 + into + 阶段名词」：three months into the job / a week into the semester。产出侧只会写 A few days after the new year began，拖沓且无「进程感」。
frames.pitfall: into 被读成空间「进入」而读慢；产出时想不到 into 能挂时间段

examples.text: A few days into the new year, Connell got a text message from Rachel Moran.

frames.frame: [未说之语], [S] could say / considers saying / feels like saying
frames.gloss: 呈现未说出口的话：把台词原样亮出，再挂 could say 等归属词串，标记它没被说出
frames.notes: Rooney 招牌装置，三章四见；台词常不加引号直陈。变体归属词串：he could say / considers saying: / feels like saying as a joke
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 He wanted to say X but didn’t，把台词包进间接引语；亮出原话再收回，才有戏

examples.text: It’s my fucking car! he could say.
People used to like me, he feels like saying as a joke.
Connell considers saying: I hope he’s really good in bed, Marianne.

frames.frame: [离谱陈述], or have I missed something?
frames.gloss: 还是说我错过了什么？（反诘：你这话有鬼）
frames.notes: 动作＝借『自我怀疑』外壳质疑对方陈述离谱。or have I missed something 是死串，前槽放一个刻意夸张的猜测。同族：or is it just me?
frames.pitfall: 读成真的在问自己漏了信息；产出只会写 I don’t understand what you mean

examples.text: Have you recently been attacked by the guards or have I missed something?

frames.frame: [糟事陈述], what do you expect?
frames.gloss: 你还想怎样？（耸肩认命式回怼）
frames.notes: 动作＝把对方的抱怨定性为『理所当然，不值得惊怪』。what do you expect 独立成句当甩手掌柜。变体 What did you expect?（事后版）
frames.pitfall: 读成真诚提问期望；产出只会写 This is normal, don’t complain

examples.text: Well, he’s a chauvinist pig, what do you expect?

frames.gloss: 设问自答降格：自抛一问（后果如何/意义何在），再以两三个词的极简答案贬抑收束
frames.notes: 叙事与口语通用；问答间无连词，靠问号+碎片制造落差。同族变体：Was it true? He didn't know enough to know that. / about what? That…?
frames.pitfall: B2 只会平铺直叙 and nothing would have happened，学不会先设问再踩扁的节奏

examples.text: and with what consequence? Nothing really.
He felt it would reassure her somehow, but about what?

frames.related: [陈述], why would [S]?

frames.frame: as if nothing (at all) had happened
frames.gloss: 「跟没事人一样」——若无其事标记
frames.notes: 动作=常态假面（宣布某人把重大事件当不存在）。死串 as if nothing had happened，可插 at all 加码。口语书面两用：She walked in as if nothing had happened. 产出侧常写出 as nothing happened 这种残句。
frames.pitfall: 过去完成时 had happened 被读成普通叙事，as if 虚拟味丢失，整句「假装没这回事」的张力没了

examples.text: and he nodded and continued driving as if nothing at all had happened, which in a way it hadn't.

frames.related: as if 族已登记（含省略变体）；本条是其高配整句版，尾注 which in a way it hadn't 是评注 which 族的刁钻变体（半真半假地撤销前句），随记不单列

frames.gloss: 一半因为A，一半也因为B（双重归因）
frames.notes: 动作＝给一件事挂两个分量相当的原因，常带自嘲。as much…as 死串对齐两个 for 槽。变体 as much [X] as [Y]（名词直接对比）
frames.pitfall: 读成『和…一样多』的数量比较；产出只会写 partly because A and partly because B

examples.text: as much for his pathetic fantasy of living in her apartment as for their failed relationship, whatever that was

frames.gloss: 「正处在那种……的年纪/阶段」——人生阶段定性
frames.notes: 动作=代际坐标定位（用 where 挂阶段特征）。死串 at that ... age where / at the stage where。闲聊共情神器：We're at that stage where we can't imagine life without it. 产出侧只会写 at an age when...（对但平），或误用 which。
frames.pitfall: where 挂在 age 后被当成语法错误跳过（先行词不是地点），漏掉口语里 where 泛化的既成事实

examples.text: I think we're at that weird age where life can change a lot from small decisions.

frames.frame: either [S V] or [S] [V-not]（同词否定回收）
frames.gloss: 要么…要么就不…，没有中间态
frames.notes: 动作＝二元对立封口，把光谱砍成非黑即白。死串 either…or+谓语原词的否定式回收（weren’t/don’t）。同族：love it or hate it
frames.pitfall: 后半的省略否定读丢，以为还有一个开放选项；产出只会写 There are only two possibilities

examples.text: you were either going out with someone or you weren’t.
You’re the kind of person, people either love you or hate you.

frames.gloss: 到处…（数落某人的一贯行径）
frames.notes: 动作＝把对方习惯性行为拎出来贬斥：going around telling everyone / hitting girls。口语高频
frames.pitfall: 解析成『走来走去地做』字面义；产出只会写 always + V-ing，丢掉游走感与贬斥味

examples.text: Do you think I'm the kind of person who would go around hitting girls?

frames.gloss: 「哪怕仅仅因为……」——理由降格强调
frames.notes: 动作=退一步也要成立的理由（别的理由都不可靠，就这一条也够）。死串 if only because。书面议论文高光件：The plan is worth trying, if only because it will expose the problem. 产出侧只会写 even if it's just because…
frames.pitfall: 与 if only（但愿）混淆读成『要是只因为就好了』；漏掉『别的先不谈，这条就成立』的退让味

examples.text: he finds he likes to be thought of as intelligent, if only because it makes his interactions with other people more legible.

frames.gloss: 「比（人们）自以为的更……」——驳自我估价
frames.notes: 动作=纠正自我估价（拿真实程度对照当事人的自我感觉）。死串 more [A] than [S] think/realize，人称可换。劝慰、点醒通用：You are more resilient than you think. 产出侧只会写 Don't underestimate yourself（喊口号，无对照结构）。
frames.pitfall: than they think they are 的尾叠被当赘余砍掉——think 管「估计」、they are 回指形容词，两层缺一不可

examples.text: People are a lot more knowable than they think they are, he adds.

frames.related: more [A] than anyone had thought（已编）——显著新变体：那条超越「旁人」预期，本条超越「自我」估价

frames.gloss: 委婉贬评：略低于期望的礼貌抱怨
frames.notes: 固定串 than ... would have liked；A 为比较级形容词。'超出容忍度'的克制版
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会说 too rubbery / not as good as he wanted；more A than sb would have liked 是把失望包在礼貌里的地道说法

examples.text: The egg was more rubbery than he would have liked.

frames.related: more [A] than anyone had thought（已登记，但那条是'超越他人预期'，此条是'低于自身容忍'）

frames.gloss: 比任何人（预先）想的都更…
frames.notes: 超越预期强调动作（判例库 2026-09-17 收录的标志性骨架，本批为语料通道原句存证）。死串 than anyone had+过去分词，槽位动词可换 warned/thought/expected/imagined
frames.pitfall: 读懂无碍，产出只会写 than people expected，夸张层级掉光

examples.text: It was so much more painful to look at her than anyone had warned him it would be

frames.frame: no more [A] than if [S were V-ed]
frames.gloss: 「跟假如…比也好不到哪去」——拿假想极端情形垫底贬低现状
frames.notes: 已登记 more [A] than anyone had thought 的显著新变体，功能不同：旧锚点是「超越预期」（抬），此变体是「不比假设的最惨情形更…」（压）。比较级 + than if 虚拟小句，死件 no more…than if。产出侧只会写 not much ownership, like a piece of litter。
frames.pitfall: than if 虚拟比较从句读慢；no more A than if B 整体是「跟B一样不A」，直接按字面顺读会绕晕

examples.text: she experiences no more ownership over her own body than if it were a piece of litter.

frames.related: more [A] than anyone had thought [B]（同族锚点，功能相反：抬升 vs 贬抑）

frames.frame: not because [X V-ed], but because [X didn’t]
frames.gloss: 反直觉归因：不是因为A，而是因为A没发生；否定回声完成归因反转
frames.notes: but 后半回声否定前半动词，是骨架最锋利处；议论/叙事通吃
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 not because it ended his life, but because it didn’t really end it，非要补全；回声否定才有那记闷拳

examples.text: not because it ended his life, but because it didn’t.

frames.related: 已登记 It isn’t that [X], but [Y]

frames.gloss: 纠正动机归因：否认表面动机，给出真实动机
frames.notes: but 后可接 to V 或 because 从句，功能一致。与已登记 It isn't that [X], but [Y] 的区别：此处专驳'因果/动机'归因而非内容判断
frames.pitfall: 学习者会说 He laughed to make her feel welcome，丢掉否认层；not because...but... 是'先排除误读'的双段动作

examples.text: not because the stories are so funny but to make Elaine feel welcome

frames.related: It isn't that [X], but [Y]（已登记）

frames.frame: not in a [A] way, but not in a [B] way either
frames.gloss: 「不算坏，但也不算真好」——两头打折扣的评价
frames.notes: 动作=委婉定位（给气味/表现/品质下折扣断言）。死串 not in a …way 挂形容词槽，either 收尾把另一头也拉回。单用前半 not in a bad way（「不算坏啦」）也高频。产出侧只会写 it's not bad but also not good，丢掉 in a …way 的轻巧
frames.pitfall: 把 way 读成『方式/道路』实义去逐词翻；或没看出 either 是把另一半也否掉的收口

examples.text: She smells like fruit liqueur, not in a bad way but not in a fully good way either.

frames.gloss: 「一点也不/毫不」——否定强化
frames.notes: 动作=彻底否定（比 not at all 更书面冷感）。死串 not remotely + 形容词/过去分词：wasn't remotely insulted / It's not remotely funny. 产出侧只会 not at all，remotely 是升级件。变体：not remotely interested / nothing remotely like X
frames.pitfall: remotely 读成『遥远地』字面义整句卡死；误以为必须谈距离

examples.text: Peggy wasn't remotely insulted, she thought it was really funny.

frames.frame: not to [V] on [that] too much, but [S V]
frames.gloss: 「那茬就不多说了，不过……」——闲笔降级后转折
frames.notes: 动作=自注降调（先把话题标记为跑题，再正式说下去）。死串 not to [V] ... too much, but。口语大家族 not to be X, but 的高频变体：Not to be dramatic, but... / Not to brag, but... 产出侧根本不知道可以这样先给自己泼冷水。
frames.pitfall: not to linger 读成「不久留」字面义；漏掉「我知道这话偏题，就说这一句」的自觉让步

examples.text: What with the depression and everything, not to linger on that too much, but you really helped me a lot.

frames.related: I'm not just saying that, (I really [V])（batch_01 candidate）同为自我评注族，方向相反：那条加码真诚，这条先降调

frames.gloss: 贴标签归类：把某人归入某类人，带疏离甚至轻蔑
frames.notes: these/those 比 a/an 多一层我群/他群距离；后常挂 who 定语 |校准复核降级: 基础泛指结构，价值密度不足
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 a campus celebrity，中性无立场；one of these campus celebrities 一眼站队

examples.text: Gareth is one of these popular people who’s involved in college societies.
He’s one of these campus celebrities, says Connell.

frames.gloss: 「近来养成了窝在家看纪录片的习惯」——染上新习惯/新爱好
frames.notes: 动作=习惯养成（带一点「迷上」的正面沉迷）。死串 take to + 动名词。产出侧只会写 I have started to / I've gotten used to，前者平淡后者方向反（used to 是适应已存在的事，take to 是主动迷上新事）。
frames.pitfall: to 后必须挂动名词（take to staying✓ / take to stay✗）；误读成「带去」义

examples.text: I've recently taken to staying home at night and watching my way through a nine part documentary series

frames.gloss: 「这不成其为（不）……的理由」——驳借口
frames.notes: 动作=拆借口（把对方刚摆出的理由降级为「不构成理由」）。死串 that's no reason to/not to。回应型骨架：I'm busy. — That's no reason to be rude. 产出侧只会写 You should still tell me anyway（直球反驳，没有句法抓手，也压不住场）。
frames.pitfall: no reason not to 的双否定逐词译会拧反（没有理由不告诉我＝应该告诉我）；阅读快时辖域判错

examples.text: Well, that's no reason not to tell me.

frames.gloss: 「我这辈子最……的一件……」——亲历极值自述
frames.notes: 动作=经历封顶（把一件事放进个人史的最高格）。死串 the + 最高级 + ever + 完成时。口语自我介绍、答谢、访谈天天用：the best decision I've ever made / the worst mistake I've ever made. 产出侧易丢 ever 或丢完成时（the best decision I made），极值感崩塌。
frames.pitfall: ever 读成「曾经某时」，没识别出「至今之最」的完成时极值搭配

examples.text: It was the best decision I've ever made in my life.

frames.related: the most [adj] thing [sb] could possibly have [V-ed]（batch_06 candidate）同族——那条是假想极值（夸张），这条是亲历极值（自述），产出侧后者高频得多

frames.gloss: 把一件事钉成「这个事实」再提为主语说它如何
frames.notes: 动作=命题名词化提主语（把整个小句当「那件事」处置）。死串 the fact that。产出侧只会写 This is possible and it unsettles her 这种平铺两句；母语者会把评价的火力全部集中到谓语上。 |校准复核降级: 语法结构层倾向，名词从句常规引导
frames.pitfall: 读的层面会把 that 从句和主句谓语的距离拉错（头重句）；产出层面常漏 the fact，写出不合语法的裸 that 主语从句

examples.text: The fact that this is even possible unsettles Marianne, and makes art seem pointless suddenly.

frames.gloss: 错误认知标定：交代某人（通常错误地）以为某事
frames.notes: mistaken 可换为相反/保留；that 从句为开放槽。比 think 错误更强调'认知状态'
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会写 he wrongly thought that...；under the impression that 是把误解当作状态的名词化表达，语气更客观讥诮

examples.text: under the mistaken impression that they are laughing at his witticism

frames.related: It occurred to sb that（已登记）

frames.gloss: 也就是说/说白了（澄清升级）
frames.notes: 动作＝把前半句翻译成更狠更直白的版本。which is to say 死串，书面口语通吃。变体 that is to say / or rather（降级修正）
frames.pitfall: 读成并列补充而非『揭底』；产出只会写 in other words

examples.text: Peggy likes Jamie, which is to say that she thinks he’s kind of a fascist

frames.gloss: （她）唯一知道的就是…
frames.notes: 已登记 What…is/was 的显著新变体：All-版伪分裂句。功能差异＝强调『认知的全部仅此』，比 What 版更口语、更决绝
frames.pitfall: All she knew 拆成两截读；产出写 The only thing she knew was（可但平）

examples.text: All she knew was that when it started, she wouldn't need to imagine it anymore.

frames.related: 已登记 What…is/was（what 版伪分裂）

frames.gloss: 即时反应衔接：闻此言/见此状，人物立刻动作
frames.notes: this 回指上一句的事件；叙事省字利器，两词完成因果衔接
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 When she heard this, Lorraine stood up，把回指拆成从句；At this 两词接骨

examples.text: At this Lorraine stood up and stripped off her gloves.

frames.gloss: （她）还没来得及…就先…
frames.notes: before + 过去完成 + even＝时机早于预期。动作＝压缩时序制造仓促感。同族：before you know it
frames.pitfall: even 漏读，『抢在之前』的意外感全丢；产出只会写 before she put

examples.text: Before she'd even put her keys on the table she said:

frames.related: 已登记 by the time（时序收束版）

frames.frame: For [sb] to [V] might/would have been [A], but...
frames.gloss: 换了别人这样做就会…，但（对他）不是
frames.notes: for NP to-V 做主语 + 情态 + 转折：动作＝『换人假设对比』，凸显特例。文学叙事与议论文都能用
frames.pitfall: for...to 结构主语读断错（当成目的状语）；产出几乎搭不出，只会写 If another person did

examples.text: For another person to laugh that way might have been cruel, but it wasn't like that with him.

frames.gloss: 双重模糊归因：先承认原因不明，再随手补一个猜测
frames.notes: for some reason（说不清）+ probably X（还是试着说）；叙事洞见腔
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 He didn’t say it, probably because he was shy，一步归因；双层归因才有人物的自我不确定

examples.text: For some reason, probably shyness, he doesn’t say it.

frames.frame: How could [X] ever be anything like [Y]?
frames.gloss: 排他性反诘：用反问否认可比性
frames.notes: ever+anything like 双重强化；答案是'根本不可能像'
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会说 they are very different；how could...ever be anything like 是断言不可比的修辞问句

examples.text: How could his feeling for her ever be anything like his feeling for other people?

frames.gloss: 「你觉得 Trinity 怎么样？」——问体验不问事实
frames.notes: 动作=体验征询。死串 how do you find + 宾语。与 What do you think of 同义但更问「过下来的体感」；产出侧几乎只会用后者，且易错产出 How do you think of✗。面试常问 How do you find living abroad?
frames.pitfall: find 读成「找到」而误解为寻找过程；产出时错造 How do you find it like✗

examples.text: How do you find Trinity, do you like it?

frames.gloss: 「估计不是/但愿不是」——裁剪式否定短答
frames.notes: 动作=态度化否定（用 that not 代替整句否定的省略格）。死串 [态度动词] not。I hope not / I should think not 书面口语两栖。产出侧只会写 I don't think so（会用），但 I assume not 这层「按推断排除」的精度造不出。
frames.pitfall: not 读成否定前句动词的挂单，没看出这是替代整个 that-从句的代词级缩略

examples.text: I mean, I assume not, he adds.

frames.related: Not that [S V]（已登记）——Not that 是撇清，I assume not 是表态否定，同 not 缩略族不同动作

frames.frame: I can't imagine what [N] would be like if [S V-ed]
frames.gloss: 「我无法想象要是……，……会是什么样」——反设夸张
frames.notes: 动作=反事实拒绝想象（用 can't imagine 的认知关闭，宣告对方处境不可理喻/不可复制）。潜台词常是自我标榜：原句=「要是我在乎别人怎么想，日子没法过」。产出侧只会写 If I cared, my life would be bad（丢了 can't imagine 的认知支架）。
frames.pitfall: 整句按真条件句处理，漏掉「想象本身就是不可能任务」的夸张承诺层

examples.text: I can't imagine what my life would be like if I cared what people thought of me.

frames.frame: I don't know how many times [S] (have) [V-ed]
frames.gloss: 「我都不知道说过多少遍了」——抱怨式重复强调
frames.notes: 动作=以「数不清」包装不耐烦（字面不知道，实际记得太清）。死串 I don't know how many times。管教、吵架开场白：I don't know how many times I've told you to knock. 产出侧只会写 I have said it many times（无火气、无控诉）。
frames.pitfall: I don't know 读成真无知；漏掉整句「我数都数烦了」的情绪定性

examples.text: I don't know how many times I have to say that to you.

frames.frame: I don't want you to think (that) [S V]
frames.gloss: 「别以为我……」——预防性澄清（完整句版）
frames.notes: 动作=预防误解，与 Not that 同族但句式完整、语气更郑重。常见双层否定结构 I don't want you to think I'm not appreciative（别以为我不领情），先否认对方可能的解读再亮真心。产出侧只会写 Don't misunderstand me（生硬）。
frames.pitfall: 嵌套否定（not think + not appreciative）读一层漏一层，整句成「我想让你觉得我不领情」反向理解

examples.text: I don't want you to think I'm not appreciative.

frames.related: Not that [S V]（batch_06 A）——Not that 是局部撇清，此条是整句版且带双层否定变体

frames.gloss: 「我希望你心里有数」——真心加戳收尾
frames.notes: 动作=真诚度背书（一大段掏心话后补一句，逼对方存档）。死串 I hope you know that / I hope you know [S V]。颁奖感言、道歉、表白收尾通用：I hope you know that none of this was your fault. 产出侧只会重复感谢内容，漏了这句终戳。
frames.pitfall: 读成普通希望（wish），漏掉「我要你永久记住」的加戳语气

examples.text: I love you more than anything and I'm very proud that you're my son. I hope you know that.

frames.frame: I know it (probably) feels like [S V], but [S V]
frames.gloss: 「我知道你感觉上是……，但是」——先收情绪再劝
frames.notes: 动作=共情预铺（先承认对方感受合理，再给出另一面）。死串 I know it feels like…, but…。安慰/谈判/议论文通吃：I know it feels like no one cares, but… 产出侧只会直接 but 顶回去，丢掉缓冲垫
frames.pitfall: feels like 读成『喜欢』；漏掉 probably 的让步加码（连『大概』都替你说了）

examples.text: I know it probably feels like they don't, he said. But at the end of the day they're your family, they love you.

frames.gloss: 预设他人观感：先承认自己的话听起来如何
frames.notes: must 为推测；常接转折或省略号（说不下去）；口语软化神器
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会写 I know it sounds strange（对）；加 must 后是'想必在你耳中'的礼貌推定，更显体贴

examples.text: I know it must sound …

frames.frame: I would say [S V] / I wouldn't say [S V] (or anything), but [S V]
frames.gloss: 「要我说我们看世界的方式挺像」/「倒不至于说我们多知己——但确实是朋友」：弱化定调
frames.notes: 动作=意见弱化/降格修正（would 假设气压低断言）。死串 I would say / I wouldn't say。口语访谈高频（记者防打脸标配）；wouldn't say…or anything, but… 是「先缩再让」的让步微框架。产出侧只会写 I think / I don't think。
frames.pitfall: would 不是过去习惯而是委婉；or anything 是「倒也没到那种程度」的回撤垫词，漏读则语气全变

examples.text: I would say we see the world in a similar way.
I wouldn't say we clicked on this very deep level or anything, but we were friends.

frames.related: [S] is (not) someone who [V]s；It's kind of [adj], what you just [V-ed]；What kind of [N] would [S] be if [X]?；What kind of [N] would [V]?；[A], or at least, [B]；[S] is somehow both [A] and [B] at the same time；[X] is a very [人名] thing to [V]；[X] might not be a bad thing

frames.gloss: 「我挺乐意/不介意去……」——低调表态
frames.notes: 动作=低姿态意愿（比 I'd like to 弱半档，客气而不谄媚）。死串 wouldn't mind + V-ing。常配 if you want 收尾：I wouldn't mind going, if you want. 产出侧只会写 I want to / I'd love to，分寸感全丢
frames.pitfall: mind 读成『头脑』；not mind 的双重否定绕晕（不是『我不介意』的防御义，是『愿意』的主动义）

examples.text: Do you want me to come? Connell says. Obviously if you don't want me there I won't go. But I wouldn't mind going, if you want.

frames.frame: I'm just asking if [S V] / I (just) mean, [S V]
frames.gloss: 「我只是问问/我只是说……」——降级澄清
frames.notes: 动作=火力降级（先声明我没别的意思，再说内容）。死串 I'm just asking / I just mean。被质问时的标准缓颊：I'm just saying, maybe check the numbers again. 产出侧会写 I only want to ask...（拧巴）或直接不设缓冲（呛人）。
frames.pitfall: just 读成「只是=仅仅」的弱化词掠过，漏掉整句给对话降压的救火功能

examples.text: But I'm just asking if you ever hear from them.
No, I just mean you must be kind of lonely, he says.

frames.related: I'm not just saying that, (I really [V])（batch_01 candidate）——同 just 自注族，那条加码，这条降档

frames.frame: I'm not just saying that, (I really [V])
frames.gloss: 我不是随口一说（是认真的）
frames.notes: 真诚加码动作：先撇清客套嫌疑再重申。变体：I don't just like you for your brains / not just as a friend。口语高频软真话框架
frames.pitfall: just 漏读则整句变成否定本身（我说的不是那个）；产出只会加 really 直译式强调

examples.text: I'm not just saying that, I really do.
I don't just like you for your brains, trust me.

frames.gloss: 预先自白：拒绝/离场前，先坦白若留下自己只会做出什么
frames.notes: only 预设不可控；自辩式预警，口语剧常用
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 If I stay I will say something I regret，全对但无那口认命的自嘲

examples.text: If I stay in the car, I’m only going to say things I’ll regret.

frames.gloss: 「这就是……的样子吗」——初见喟叹
frames.notes: 动作=新鲜感喟叹（把抽象名词第一次落到实处，自问自失）。死串 what X is like 做表语。ch10 原句问的不是『生活是什么』而是『生活原来长这样？』。产出侧把 like 漏掉写成 Is this what life is，语义变成下定义
frames.pitfall: what life is like 的 like（『……的样子』）误当喜欢/像，漏掉整句是问样貌不是问本体

examples.text: Is this what life is like? Connell said.

frames.related: batch_06『what [X] is/are for』同族：what-系表语框架

frames.frame: It doesn't/hasn't done [sb] any good to [V]
frames.gloss: 「……从来没用/没好处」——无效性判词
frames.notes: 动作=宣判某行为徒劳。死串 do sb any good（any 是否定/疑问配件）。it has never done her any good to tell anyone——说了从来没好处。产出侧只会写 it's useless to do，丢掉 do good 的受益结构。变体：It wouldn't do you any good to argue
frames.pitfall: good 读成『好东西』名词找宾语；any 漏掉导致否定句写成 no any good

examples.text: But it's too late now, and anyway it has never done her any good to tell anyone.

frames.gloss: 印证前述：外置 wh-小句回指前面的话，先盖章再展开
frames.notes: 口语叙事式 extraposition；后文常接对该话的具体兑现
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 What she said about Connell was true，语法对但没人这么说话；it 前置版才有回望腔

examples.text: It was true what she had said about Connell.

frames.related: 已登记 It’s not like [S V]；It isn’t that [X], but [Y]

frames.frame: It wasn't the [N] [S] was hoping [for/从句]
frames.gloss: 期望落空低调表达：用'不是我所盼的那种'代替直接失望
frames.notes: N 为 outcome/conclusion/response 类结果名词；hoping 后可接 for 或从句
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会说 he was disappointed；not the X (that) I was hoping for 把失望对象化，更有回甘

examples.text: It wasn’t the conclusion he was hoping the conversation would have

frames.gloss: 某人（居然）做出这种事，真是…
frames.notes: 人品归因评价：rude/kind/brave of sb to do。of 引人、for 引事是分界。文中以 it had been rude of her even to... 出现，even 嵌入再加码
frames.pitfall: of/for 产出互串（It's rude for her）；even to 位置读错

examples.text: as if it had been rude of her even to make reference to the kiss

frames.gloss: 「说到底这是……的问题」——重新定性（书面腔）
frames.notes: 动作=改换案件类别（不否认事实，改判性质）。死串 it's more a case of。把口语话题升格成分析口吻：It's not laziness, it's more a case of burnout. 产出侧只会写 it's more about...（接近但少 case 的判例味）。
frames.pitfall: case 读成「案例」实义卡壳；漏掉「换个案由定性」的术语化改判功能

examples.text: I think it's more a case of reputational damage.

frames.gloss: 「没那么……」——与预期暗比的弱化否定
frames.notes: 动作=降温（针对对方或自己期待打折）。死串 not that + 形容词：It's not that enjoyable / I'm not that busy / It's not that deep. that 是弱化副词（= so），暗含『比起你们以为的』。产出侧只会 not very，丢掉暗比层。ch09 原句（男权『没那么爽』）正是妙用
frames.pitfall: that 读成指示代词『那个』，整句『不是那个好玩的』读死；漏掉与预期对比的言外之意

examples.text: It's like Marianne was saying, he replies. It's not that enjoyable to have.

frames.frame: It's such a stupid thing, but [I'm curious whether/Q]
frames.gloss: 「问个特傻的问题，但我就是想知道」——自贬预铺提问
frames.notes: 动作=提问降格（先把问题骂一顿再问，卸掉尴尬）。死串 It's such a stupid thing, but + 问句/curious whether。同族：Can I just ask something? / Sorry if that's insensitive to say. 产出侧硬着头皮直问，丢掉垫子
frames.pitfall: 读成真在自贬（其实问题照问）；curious whether 后面接陈述语序（不是疑问倒装）没反应过来

examples.text: Did you ever think about asking me to the Debs? she said. It's such a stupid thing but I'm curious whether you thought about it.
Can I just ask something? says Peggy.

frames.gloss: 叙事预叙：叙述者提前预告人物日后才有的念头
frames.notes: would 为过去将来；预叙反思/怀疑类心理活动最典型
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会写 he often wondered later（平铺）；Later he would wonder... 是小说叙事的标志性开场，预知感强

examples.text: Later he would wonder if he was really defending Marianne or just defending himself from an implied accusation about his own sexuality

frames.gloss: （或许）是因为…吧
frames.notes: 口语片段答语：不重建全句，直接抛 Maybe because + 从句。动作＝给出不完整解释（不确定、不给定论）。变体 Probably because / Just because I felt like it
frames.pitfall: 当成残句以为说话人语法差；产出硬要补全 Maybe it is because，生硬

examples.text: Maybe because you blush a lot when she talks to you.

frames.gloss: 「对 Rob 而言最重要的莫过于别人的认可」——极限排位
frames.notes: 动作=最高级归位（以 nothing 起手扫空一切再让 X 登顶）。死串 Nothing V-ed more to sb than。感谢/剖白场景高频（Nothing means more to me than your support）。与 nothing less than（已登记）同为极限强调但句法独立。变体：Nothing mattered to him except…（ch15 意群）。
frames.pitfall: to sb 的与格挂靠（more to him than）读的层面易滑过；产出侧只会写 X was the most important thing for him

examples.text: Nothing had meant more to Rob than the approval of others

frames.related: nothing less than/nothing short of（已登记，极限抬升族）

frames.gloss: 「直到后来才知道/才发现」——迟到信息倒装
frames.notes: 动作=时间延宕揭示（当时不知，事后才知）。死串 Only later + 助动词前置倒装。课本级语法（Only then did I realize），但产出侧几乎无人主动用——雅思写作换装件：Only later did it become clear that… 变体：Only later did she find out / Only now does he understand
frames.pitfall: 读时把 Only later 当普通时间状语滑过，漏掉倒装；产出忘了助动词提前，写出 Only later he found out

examples.text: Only later did he find out that this presentation was considered very impressive.

frames.gloss: 排除法归因：先立一个结论，再用'否则无法解释'支撑
frames.notes: otherwise 承接前句结论（I must deserve it.）；逻辑为反证法，常用于自我定罪或指认他人
frames.pitfall: 学习者只会写 maybe that's why it happened；Otherwise I don't know why... 把归因逼成二选一，心理压迫感强

examples.text: Otherwise I don’t know why it would happen.

frames.gloss: 「这都算不上A，这就是B」——降格改判
frames.notes: 动作=重新定性（先撤销对方给的定性，再换成更低一格的）。死串 not even ... that's just ...。辟谣、灭high都用：That's not even gossip, that's just how lads behave. 产出侧只会写 It's not A, but B（丢掉 even 的降格力度）。
frames.pitfall: even 的「连A都不配算」读成强调词掠过；漏掉整句的贬格改判动作

examples.text: But like, that's not even gossip, that's just how lads behave.

frames.gloss: 绝境宣告：存在否定+双层定语从句，宣告无处可逃
frames.notes: 第二层 that would 是骨架关键（逃到哪儿都于事无补）
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 She can’t go anywhere to escape this，一层就断；双层从句才有困死感

examples.text: There’s nowhere she can go that would free her from this.

frames.related: 已登记 There is no [V-ing]

frames.gloss: 「现在回头看……」——分词式今昔回望
frames.notes: 动作=时间轴切换（把叙述者拉回当下，与过去拉开距离再评一句）。死串 V-ing about it now（分词 + now 双标记）。回忆录、复盘访谈开口即用：Thinking about it now, I probably overreacted. 产出侧只会写 When I think about it now（完整从句，可，但慢半拍）。
frames.pitfall: 分词悬垂当成病句跳过；漏掉「现在时点回望过去」的叙事者站位

examples.text: Thinking about it now, she can't understand why it bothered her.

frames.gloss: 「就这水平？」——贬评反问
frames.notes: 动作=以失望为名的嘲讽（把对方的顶格产出亮出来打脸）。死串 the best sb can do / come up with。问句语调（不真求答）是灵魂：This is the best you can come up with? 产出侧只会写 Is this all you can do?
frames.pitfall: 读成真心的最高级夸赞（漏掉反问）；come up with 当『上来』字面拆

examples.text: They control the whole social system and this is the best they can come up with for themselves?

frames.frame: What do you expect me to do, (just) [V]?
frames.gloss: 「你还要我怎样——装作没看见？」：反诘收尾，把荒谬选项甩回给对方
frames.notes: 动作=反诘抛回。死串 what do you expect me to do, just + 动词原形。吵架圣器；just 是点睛死词（「就这么…得了」）。产出侧只会写 What should I do then。同族短版：I don't know what you expected（ch15，事后版「你还想要什么效果」）。
frames.pitfall: just 在此非「仅仅」而是「索性就这么…」的赌气状语；漏读会错过整个怼人的动作

examples.text: what do you expect me to do, just pretend I don't notice

frames.related: I don't know what you expected.（ch15，事后复盘版）

frames.gloss: 荒谬反问自辩：把指控的前提（有时间/有机会）本身做成反问驳回
frames.notes: 已登记 Why are you even V-ing 之显著变体：功能差异在此为自辩驳回指控，彼为质疑他人行为
frames.pitfall: B2 会说 I don’t have time for that，防御姿态弱；反问版把指控直接架空

examples.text: When would I even have time?

frames.related: 已登记 Why are you even V-ing

frames.gloss: 「你说了算」——顺从式短答（温度两极）
frames.notes: 动作=全权让渡（省略主句只留 wh-ever 短答）。Whenever you want 是敞开供应（随时奉陪），However you want 是随你怎么来，If that's what you want 则偏冷（随你便）。语气靠重音与场合，结构上都是 wh-ever/回声收尾的碎句。产出侧会写成完整句 you can do it any time you want（对但累赘）。
frames.pitfall: 读成没说完的话等下半句；漏掉短答本身「一切由你」的让渡宣告

examples.text: Whenever you want to.
However you want.
Yeah. If that's what you want.

frames.frame: You’re saying [X] is the issue, but I don’t think that’s what it is
frames.gloss: 复述驳斥：先复述对方的归因，再当面判定症结不在彼处
frames.notes: 口语论辩框架：echo + that’s not what it is；可泛化为 You’re saying X, but that’s not what it is
frames.pitfall: B2 会直接说 No, that’s not the problem，少了先复述再拆的那层认真对待

examples.text: You’re saying that’s what the issue is, but I honestly don’t think that’s what it is.

frames.related: [X] is one thing; [Y] is another

frames.gloss: 「……，尽管时有……」——让步 if（嵌在名词短语里）
frames.notes: 动作=内嵌让步（用一个 if 形容词插入语，不另起让步从句）。a process of adjustment that has been steady if sometimes painful ＝ 虽时有阵痛但总体平稳。书面点评腔：an honest, if flawed, account. 产出侧只会写 although it is sometimes painful（整句让步，笨重）。
frames.pitfall: if 读成条件义「如果是」，在形容词间迷失；漏掉这是 if 的让步用法

examples.text: a process of adjustment that has been steady if sometimes painful

frames.gloss: 冒号把笼统名词落到具体命题上——「她一直听到的那些话：她有病、她需要帮助」
frames.notes: 动作=先总后具体（下定义/具体化）。死件是冒号+that 完整小句（非同位语紧贴，而是隔开复指）。写作里给 claim / message / suggestion 落地的利器；产出侧只会写 …, which was that… 或直接两句平铺。
frames.pitfall: 读的层面在冒号处断错气口，把 that 从句误挂到最近名词上；产出层面想不到冒号能接完整 that 从句

examples.text: it was hard to dismiss something she had admittedly been hearing all her life from various sources: that she was mentally unwell and needed help.

frames.gloss: 「竟能养出一身精致趣味，却从头到尾没长出半点是非观」——全程为零的对照
frames.notes: 动作=全程归零强调（做了 A 这么久，B 一次都没有）。死串 without ever + 动名词。讽刺评点的利器（He built a career without ever answering a question directly.）；产出侧只会写 but he never developed…，丢掉 without ever 的「伴随全程」密度。
frames.pitfall: ever 在否定语境里的「任何时候都」穷尽义被读成「曾经」；整句反讽要 A/B 两半对读才成立

examples.text: He has managed to nurture a fine artistic sensitivity without ever developing any real sense of right and wrong.

frames.gloss: 「……，而且他自己心里清楚」——自我知情尾注
frames.notes: 动作=知情加戳（陈述后补一句对方/自己明知如此）。死串 and he knows he has（尾动词与被省略部分同形回指）：He has cultivated it, and he knows he has. 口语版 and I know I did / and you know you did. 心理剖析与自白通用。
frames.pitfall: 尾句 knows he has 读成新信息（他还拥有什么），没识别出这是前句动词的回指缩略

examples.text: In fact he has cultivated it, and he knows he has.

frames.gloss: 「果然，还真是」——宿命感确认小句
frames.notes: 动作=自嘲式果然（重放主句动词，确认世界按剧本走）。死串 of course + 主语+替代动词（does/it is）。叙事者口吻专用，口语也有：You said no, of course you did. 产出侧只会写 as expected 且放在句首，丢掉挂尾回放的自嘲味
frames.pitfall: 把 of course he does 当独立评注句滑过，漏掉它回放的是前句主语；产出时用 it 乱替

examples.text: Connell comes around the corner, of course he does.

frames.gloss: 「（不听劝/不管那么多）照做不误」
frames.notes: 动作=越过犹豫照办（常带『明知不该还是干了』）。死串 go ahead and + 动词原形。ch08 反用：she doesn't go ahead and do them anyway（她不是那种人）。口语高频：I just went ahead and did it. 产出侧只会写 do it anyway，丢掉 go ahead and 的推土机节奏
frames.pitfall: 拆成 go ahead『前进』+ and 并列两动作，读成『先走然后做』；漏掉 anyway 的顶风感

examples.text: but when Joanna disapproves of things she doesn't go ahead and do them anyway.

frames.frame: [S] go/went through [one's] whole life without ever [V-ing]
frames.gloss: 一辈子从未曾…（终身否定铺陈）
frames.notes: 核心死串是 without ever＋V-ing：『不曾有一次』的强化否定。动作＝把缺席推到一生尺度。变体 without ever having V-ed
frames.pitfall: ever 漏读后语气从『从未曾』弱化成『没有』；产出写 without never 双重否定错

examples.text: go through their whole lives, Marianne thought, without ever really feeling that close with anyone

frames.gloss: 责任反转镜像：分号两侧同动词镜像，把责任从外部翻回自身（或反之）
frames.notes: 书面修辞；第二半用反身代词收口。可镜像出 No one fooled me; I fooled myself
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 She deceived herself, not because he deceived her，绕一大圈；镜像句一击

examples.text: He had never tried to delude her into thinking she was socially acceptable; she’d deluded herself.

frames.gloss: 隐隐觉得/有种感觉是…
frames.notes: 模糊感知的报道框架，与 It occurred to sb 同族不同功能：occurred＝念头一闪，had the sense＝持续的直觉。变体 a sense that / the feeling that
frames.pitfall: sense 读成『感官/道理』（make sense 污染）；产出只会写 I felt that，丢掉认知折扣味

examples.text: Marianne had the sense that her real life was happening somewhere very far away

frames.related: It occurred to [sb]（闪现版）

frames.frame: [S] had thought [X would V], but it only [V-ed]
frames.gloss: 预期反转：原以为会怎样，结果只是更糟/变了味
frames.notes: had thought 前置预埋 + but it only（只是）收刀；but it only 是固定连片
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 he thought it would help but it didn’t，停在单纯否定；only+具体化才有变本加厉感

examples.text: He had thought that being with her would make him feel less lonely, but it only gave his loneliness a new stubborn quality

frames.related: 已登记 only to [V]

frames.gloss: 「会杀了我的」——戏谑后果夸张
frames.notes: 动作=借第三方威慑做推脱/警告。死串 would kill sb，条件隐身（要是……的话）。口语天天见：My mom would kill me. / Lorraine would kill me（冰淇淋化了）。产出侧只会写 she will be very angry，丢掉夸张的喜剧感
frames.pitfall: 读成真实威胁或将来时；漏掉 would 的虚拟义（还没发生、纯预演）

examples.text: Oh, I would, but there's ice cream in the boot.
Lorraine would kill me, he says.

frames.gloss: 爱尔兰完成体：be after doing = 刚刚做了/已经得了
frames.notes: Hiberno-English 特征结构；识别价值大于产出价值（雅思考场慎用，影视/口语认读必备）
frames.pitfall: B2 会读错为追求（after chasing）或进行时；实为完成义

examples.text: Annie Kearney’s after getting five-seventy!

frames.gloss: （他）只是一时这样，不是本性如此
frames.notes: be being + adj＝临时状态 vs 本性。动作＝为对方行为撇清定性：He's just being nice / She's just being difficult。进行体表暂时性是其语法底
frames.pitfall: 进行体误读为『正在当』；产出不会用 be being，只会写 he is temporarily

examples.text: She's probably just being glib and not suggestive

frames.gloss: 你这架势倒像是…（指摘对方举止）
frames.notes: act like + 完整从句＝当面指摘框架：You're acting like you've never seen it before. 比 behave as if 口语得多
frames.pitfall: like 后从句读断错；产出写 You behave as if...（书卷气错位）

examples.text: You're acting like you've never kissed anyone before.

frames.gloss: 「我慢慢开始明白了」——渐悟承认
frames.notes: 动作=认知上坡（现在进行时把「懂」变成正在发生的过程）。get 代替 understand 的口语芯。性别议题那句 It's different for men / Yeah, I'm starting to get that 是标准回敬格式。产出侧只会写 I understand now（跳过了过程）。
frames.pitfall: get 读成「得到」；进行时被当成啰嗦，漏掉「不情愿但正在被说服」的渐进感

examples.text: Yeah, I'm starting to get that.

frames.gloss: 「短信上写着/牌子上写的是……」——引文挂载体
frames.notes: 动作=把文字内容挂到实物载体上（read=上面写着，不及物用法）。死串 [载体] read: + 引文。叙事/报道通用：The note read: Gone to the shops. 产出侧只会写 the message said，read 这个不及物用法是盲区
frames.pitfall: read 读成『读』的动作义，等宾语等不到卡住；漏掉过去式 read 同形的时态

examples.text: You should be with someone who takes you seriously, the message read.

frames.gloss: 回指驳推论：承认前半句，但否认从它推出的结论
frames.notes: that 回指整句前文；与已登记 Just because [X] doesn't mean [Y] 的区别：本条是'先摆事实再驳推论'的两步结构，that 承接上文任意命题
frames.pitfall: 学习者会说 but they don't hate you，丢掉 that doesn't mean 的回指驳论层

examples.text: I know you fight with them, he says, but that doesn’t mean they hate you.

frames.related: Just because [X] doesn't mean [Y]（已登记）

frames.gloss: 「即使不到 Y，至少也是 X」——递进补白
frames.notes: 动作=保守估计再加码（X 是底线，Y 是可能的天花板）。死串 , if not + 名词/比较级：three girlfriends, if not more / a mistake, if not a crime. 产出侧只会写 or even，丢掉『底线已稳』的口吻
frames.pitfall: if not 读成『如果不』条件义整句读反；漏掉逗号是补白不是条件

examples.text: If I were a man, she says, I would have as many as three girlfriends. If not more.

frames.related: as many as [N]（高达）同句连用：先夸张再补刀

frames.gloss: 「就是 TA（让我……的）」——锁定当事人
frames.notes: 动作=归责/归功定点（把动作源头钉到一个人身上，言下之意「别怀疑别人」）。死串 be the one who，变体 the one to [V]（she was the one to call）。八卦、复盘、表功高频：He's the one who got me into this. 产出侧只会写 She told me to apply（丢了排他归因）。
frames.pitfall: the one 读成「那个人」泛指；漏掉 who 从句的归责指向——「源头是 TA 不是我」

examples.text: She's the one who told me to apply.

frames.gloss: ……，她心想/他得出结论说，……（句中插评注）
frames.notes: 标点对（逗号对）撑住的 Rooney 签名结构：报道动词插在句子正中，自由间接引语标配。动词槽开放但骨架＝插入位置+逗号对。动作＝即时挂靠心理活动
frames.pitfall: 读断句错位（把插入语当主句）；产出只敢句末加 she thought

examples.text: To wear make-up for this occasion would be, she concludes, embarrassing.

frames.frame: [主语], [she has realised / he thought], [谓语剩余]
frames.gloss: 主谓中间插一手心理评注——「这种鉴赏力，她后来意识到，并不能让他成为好人」
frames.notes: 动作=叙述中插心理评注（分句插叙）。死件是逗号对标点对：主语与谓语被「主语+认知动词」插入语硬拆。自由间接引语小说的天标配；读的层面典型读慢点（把插入语误当主句）。产出侧几乎无人敢拆主谓。变体：Now, he thought, even that effect was spoiled（ch15）。
frames.pitfall: 读慢：This quality of discernment 之后等谓语等来的是 she has realised，误判主句易回头重读；He could not, it's too appalling to consider, actually have hurt feelings?（ch15）连情态动词都被拆

examples.text: This quality of discernment, she has realised, does not make Lukas a good person.
She looked, he thought, almost frail.

frames.frame: [时间量] [S V-ed] to [获得X], and all [S] [V]s it for is [Y]
frames.gloss: 付出落差感慨：时长前置强调苦功，后半 all…for is 卖个降格用途
frames.notes: 两个装置合用：时量前置（Three years he worked…）与 all [S] [V]s it for is（就干这个用）；讽刺/自嘲均可
frames.pitfall: B2 会写 He worked for two and a half years to buy this car, but he only uses it to…，全部摊平；前置+all…for is 才有那声叹息

examples.text: Two and a half years he worked in the garage after school to buy this car
and all he uses it for is driving his mother around because she doesn’t have a licence.

frames.related: 已登记 What…is/was；[时间量] into [阶段]

frames.gloss: 「光是……就满足了」——安于低配

frames.gloss: 「万一真到了……的时候」——半信半疑的条件

frames.frame: if, like, certain things were different
frames.gloss: 「要是某些事情不一样的话」——含糊虚拟支吾
frames.notes: 动作=模糊指涉（能虚拟、不肯说破）。死串 certain things were different，certain 是全句的烟幕弹：说话人心里有具体所指，故意不点名。情场、职场都见：Things would be easier if certain people were more cooperative. 产出侧要么说破（伤人），要么干瘪（if things were different）。

frames.frame: not see what there is to [V] (about [X])
frames.gloss: 「看不出有什么可……的」——对他人反应的不解

frames.gloss: 「最接近……的一次，不过是……」——贴线丈量

frames.gloss: 「种种审美失手里最微末的那种」——从一类里抽出极端个体

frames.gloss: 「（某人）如今变成的这副样子」——自我指认
